source.rule: MaterielOperationalModes sets a relative USERT for a reliability block; values below, equal to, or above 1 operate it less, equally, or more than the overlying block. Manual p200 and the dictionary permit nonnegative floats, so zero is within schema. The rate is multiplicative in RBD hierarchy and affects corrective and operation-dependent preventive maintenance.

configuration.shared: Accepted G09.var01 mixed BASIC h8/PAR h20/BASIC h32 schedule, two-position series/active parallel, one aircraft, direct half-hour CM, seed1/replication1/horizon36. In all four arms reduce only POS-A ordinary OPHOURS FRQ300000 to positive 1e-9 to remove the competing A failure; retain POS-B FRQ600000. Add G09-B-USE selected only for BASIC series POS-B; PAR POS-B remains G04-OPS/USERT1.
configuration.panel: Within-panel only ProblemDescription and POS-B/G09-B-USE MaterielOperationalModes.USERT change: 0, 0.5, 1, 2. Parent-to-panel also changes A ordinary FRQ, adds the B mode definition/row and BASIC B selector.

pre_run_hypotheses: All four arms convert with zero errors and reviewed diagnostics, preserve exact populated-table import/export roundtrips and produce nonempty native SXO/event log/report.

With common POS-A FRQ1e-9, no POS-B ordinary fault occurs during BASIC at USERT0; each nonzero usage arm has at least one POS-B ordinary fault during BASIC, yielding a direct zero/half/full/double panel. Exact times and later stochastic event order are empirical, and rates alone do not guarantee matched draws.
PAR POS-B retains G04-OPS/USERT1 and remains in the active parallel RBD in all four arms. Its actual event times and outcomes are empirical.
Each report reconciles mission outcome, ordinary failure/repair counts, 72 aligned System/Stock bins, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Four immutable guarded serial session-0 SSH runs with host mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen accepted-parent/preliminary-panel/source fingerprints and 13 raw SHA-256 seals each.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed diagnostics, nonempty native output, exact events/mission/repair/report/ledger reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay of the four-arm rate boundary and separately sealed preliminary panel. Selected USERT may remain source/roundtrip-bound because native event logs do not print it.
diagnostic_gate: If any arm has converter errors, unreviewed warnings or failed roundtrip, or if a nonzero arm lacks a BASIC POS-B fault or zero has one, preserve the runs as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID without changing this contract.
limits: BASIC POS-B series block at USERT0/0.5/1/2 with common positive near-zero A ordinary rate; PAR B fixed USERT1; one aircraft, mission schedule, seed and replication. The accepted parent has A FRQ300000, so cross-panel event differences cannot be attributed to USERT alone.

Selected mode and rate are source/roundtrip-bound. The four observed seeded fault times do not establish a general reciprocal hazard or matched-draw law, population reliability, other rates/topologies, operation-dependent PM, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.

preliminary_panel.reason: The half-rate arm was preempted by POS-A in BASIC, so it did not directly expose POS-B under fractional usage. This accepted-gate-passing panel is retained as preliminary evidence, not the published rate boundary.
